conversion: Generated alpha retained. ImageMagick WebP encoding at quality 91 for scenes and 94 for numeral atlas; no repainting or background substitution.
liveContent: LINK count, clear count and integer medal WIN are provided by the native award event. Numerals and the comma are individually composed from the generated lettering atlas. The amount is labelled as the cumulative award when cue.total is true.

prompts.award-link: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster artwork for a premium Japanese sweets arcade game called Cookie Link. Create ONE isolated transparent-background celebration illustration, wide landscape 1536x1024 composition. This is a deployable game popup, not a screenshot or poster. Spectacularly polished hand-painted 3D confectionery craftsmanship: realistic baked butter biscuit edges, embossed golden caramel, piped ivory cream, glossy strawberry jam, tiny sugar crystals, soft warm reflections. An open celebratory pile of scalloped shortbread cookies, jam-heart biscuits and swirling ribbons surrounds a large sculpted typographic logo in the upper-middle reading EXACTLY 'LINK!' in exuberant cream-gold cookie lettering with toasted edges, thick shiny cranberry-red shadow, three dimensional chocolate extrusion and small sugar highlights. Letters themselves are edible artwork, not a font pasted over a blank rectangle. Logo centered at 37% image height, occupies middle 65% width. Beautiful cookie/cream sculptural crest above the text at 14% and crumb clusters at the outside corners. Below the LINK! logo, a small empty cranberry silk ribbon at 56% height is reserved for dynamic Japanese live text. Below that, reserve a clean open pale honey glow area at x=22%-78%, y=64%-80% for the live payout number. Do not put objects, baked-in numbers or text into that area. At the bottom, a lightly curved shortbread and cream pedestal with caramel scrolls at 88% height, with two small jam biscuits on either side. No giant enclosing frame, no flat rectangular panel, no dark purple/brown blank middle, no generic shield. The composition is an open food sculpture with layered depth, warm luminous center, asymmetric natural biscuit clusters, sugar star sparks close to the sculpture only. Outer background actually transparent alpha, no checkerboard/no solid backdrop. Keep all illustrated pixels 5% away from canvas edges. No numbers, no currency signs, no extra words, no watermark. Only word LINK! is baked into art. The scene must remain legible when scaled down to about 350px wide in a game.
prompts.award-clear: Create the matching ALL CLEAR achievement artwork by transforming this Cookie Link celebration image. Production transparent-background raster asset, same wide 1536x1024 composition and same exquisitely rendered baked biscuit, strawberry jam, ivory cream and caramel materials. Replace the LINK! typography with EXACTLY 'ALL CLEAR!' in two exuberant centered lines of sculpted thick golden shortbread lettering, caramel/gold bevels, white icing highlights, rich ruby strawberry-jam extrusion. Make this the highest award: at the top, a grand small golden biscuit crown with a jam jewel; a fan of butter biscuits behind the words; stacked cookies and whipped cream columns on the far left and right, a few pink/gold sugar-star sparks and edible sugar pearls. The title's two lines together occupy y=20%-52%, filling x=14%-86%. The whole illustration must be distinctly more celebratory and grand than the LINK image, an open cookie feast, not another identical outline. A small empty deep red silk ribbon spans x=26%-74% at y=58%-64% for dynamic Japanese text. A clear, luminous pale custard space x=21%-79%, y=67%-81% is reserved for the actual payout digits: no baked-in numbers, no objects in that safe area. Delicious scalloped cookie-and-cream base at y=87%-94%, with strawberry biscuits at lower outer corners and a small golden heart accent. The composition stays inside all edges with 4% transparent margin. Actual transparent alpha around the sculpture and softly glowing edges. No opaque background, no checkerboard, no watermark, no other text, no amounts. Keep title ALL CLEAR! exact and legible at 350px display width. Preserve quality, appetizing warm palette, shiny edible crafted lettering and relief texture of reference.
prompts.award-digits: Use case: stylized-concept. A precise production typography sprite atlas for Cookie Link, a luxury sweet arcade game. One square 1536x1536 transparent PNG containing exactly TWELVE isolated glyph sprites in a strict four columns by three rows grid. Each cell is 384x512 pixels, no grid lines. Equal vertical baseline, equal cap height, generous transparent gutters. First row: '0' '1' '2' '3'. Second row: '4' '5' '6' '7'. Third row: '8' '9' ',' 'WIN'. The comma is naturally a small punctuation at the normal baseline. WIN is one small word, fully fits in its cell. All numerals are exquisitely polished sculpted golden caramel serif characters with cream-white upper face highlights, warm yellow-gold lower face, rich caramel bevel, substantial dark strawberry-jam red inner extrusion, dark chocolate-brown thin outer contour, polished gold rim, subtle sugar grain. Highly legible isolated 3D jackpot typography, richly illustrated rather than flat vector. Every numeral identical cap height (350px tall), fully centered in each cell, no shadows or decorations spilling across cells. Crisp edges and strong brown outlines visible over pale cream. Face is clear smooth luminous pale gold, no big cracks or decorative motifs crossing numeral counters. The word WIN uses the same layered gold/caramel type. No cookies, no crown, no berries, no background, no glow outside each character silhouette, no checkerboard, no labels, no amounts, no extra text. Real alpha outside each individual glyph. Exactly the specified 12 sprites, neatly registered for programmatic slicing.
